clips.title: The story
paras: Seereth Stonebreak sends word from Stonetalon to Thunder Bluff. Enraged by goblin deforestation and mining, the mountain's elements need spiritual guidance, so Seereth sends emissaries to seek counsel from Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise.

Goblin deforestation and mining have enraged the elemental spirits of Stonetalon Mountains. Seereth Stonebreak sees that force alone cannot ease the land's spiritual anguish and turns to elder shamans for wisdom. Seereth knows few tribal leaders by name, but knows of Magatha Grimtotem, an elder famed for her knowledge and commanding presence.

Magatha Grimtotem holds court atop Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, where shamanic and spiritual affairs gather. The Grimtotem tribe's relationship with Cairne Bloodhoof's leadership is tense and often confrontational. Even so, Magatha is a formidable elder whose counsel carries great weight across the Horde. You bring Stonetalon's troubles to her, seeking her guidance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To truly tend the spirits of Stonetalon we must consult the tauren elders.
I do not know many of their leaders' names, but I do know of one: Magatha. I have heard that she is very old, and she knows much. If anyone can marshal spiritual aid from the tauren, it is she.
Magatha resides in the tauren capital of Thunder Bluff, on Elder Rise—the city's northeastern bluff. Speak with Magatha, and tell her of the peril of Stonetalon Mountains.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I bid you greetings. You are here seeking counsel?
